mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for future corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the average return is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of central bank rate cuts and triggers positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 8.0% for 3 months, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which increases the probability of monetary policy accommodation and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 65% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases recession risk and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95.0 for two months, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that may delay rate cuts, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS >= 0.15%, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 400,000 million dollars, combined with rising industrial production (INDPRO), indicates strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS > 400,000 and INDPRO > 97.0 fails to generate positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 65% of cases, or the interaction term is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a tightening labor market that may prompt the Fed to raise rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200,000 and UNRATE declines > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 200,000 and UNRATE declines > 0.2pp, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 2.0% annualized growth, observed over a 6-month window, signals a weakening economy, which increases the likelihood of fiscal or monetary stimulus and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 55% of periods when GDPC1 < 2.0% annualized for 6 months, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
